simple.meaning: בִּגְוַי (Bigvay) is a Hebrew word meaning “Bigvai , an Israelite.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.

definitions.full: H902. Bigvay בִּגְוַי proper name, masculine (compare Sanskrit bhagavân, happy) ?) 1 a companion of Zerubbabel Ezra 2:2 = Neh 7:7 ; perhaps = head of a family of returning exiles Ezra 2:14 ( בִּגְוָ֑י ) = Neh 7:19 , compare Ezra 8:14 . 2 a chief of the people in Nehemiah's time Neh 10:17 ; compare Sm Listen 13 . בִּגְלַל see גלל . p. 164 ff
